# Requirement table rows extracted verbatim from CreditProbe_Guided_Risk_Workspace_Master_Prompt_v3.1 (30 Sep 2026).
# Source of the requirement ids for scripts/guided_workspace/requirement_matrix.py; regenerate from the document, do not edit.
| UAT-01 | Method selection was bypassed | After scenario/stage confirmation, the system executed a Delta-like calculation without asking the user to choose Delta, ML, User-defined, or comparison. This is a governance/control-flow failure; no silent method default is allowed. |
| UAT-02 | ECL decomposition is insufficient | Current output is dominated by a basic borrower bar chart and tables. A reconciled ECL bridge/decomposition plus richer interactive views are mandatory. |
| UAT-03 | Stage migration visualization is too basic | The current 2x2 stage movement display is informative but visually weak. Replace/augment with a Plotly Sankey/alluvial and richer before/after stage views. |
| UAT-04 | Scenario chaining is ambiguous | If a second scenario is requested after an executed scenario, the system must ask whether to apply it to the original reported baseline or on top of the prior stressed scenario unless the user already states the choice. |
| UAT-05 | Display units are noisy | The UI repeatedly prints “SAR million” in column headers, cells, chart axes and labels. Internal units remain unchanged, but presentation must become concise, adaptive and semantically correct. |
| UAT-06 | What-If workbench is incomplete | The existing Stress Testing navigation must become a complete What-If Analysis workbench with the AdvancedCockpit chat at top, latest-period data grid below, column-level filters, cohort selection, scenario application and results. |
| UAT-07 | Mac launch must be one-click and honest | The completed feature must have a launcher that verifies Python 3.12, frontend dependencies, candidate lake, compatibility release, ML artifacts, model/price config and credential, and starts only its own runtime. It must never print a green URL before health checks pass. |
| UAT-08 | Method-1 semantic audit required | Audit the current “Delta” implementation against the approved definition: proportional risk-parameter change should translate proportionally to booked ECL. Do not silently call an EAD×PD×LGD recomputation “Delta” if its baseline/mathematics differ. Correct labels/math explicitly and test them. |
| UAT-09 | Dual-scope ECL decomposition must be simultaneous | A scenario applied to one customer, a selected cohort or a sub-portfolio must show the ECL decomposition for that selected scope AND the ECL decomposition for the entire active Corporate/Retail book in the same response. The selected-scope delta, rest-of-book delta and total-book delta must reconcile. This is not optional drill-down. |

| M002 | ECL change | Both | ECL_t - ECL_t-1 | SAR | Lower | portfolio/segment-period | Absolute period movement |
| M003 | ECL change % | Both | (ECL_t/ECL_t-1)-1 | % | Lower | portfolio/segment-period | Null if prior ECL <=0 |
| M004 | Stage 1 EAD share | Both | SUM(EAD stage1)/SUM(EAD) | % | Context | portfolio-period | Exclude invalid/missing stage from denominator and disclose |
| M005 | Stage 2 EAD share | Both | SUM(EAD stage2)/SUM(EAD) | % | Lower | portfolio-period | SICR stock indicator |
| M006 | Stage 3 EAD share | Both | SUM(EAD stage3)/SUM(EAD) | % | Lower | portfolio-period | Default/impaired stock |

| M008 | Stage 3 ECL share | Both | SUM(ECL stage3)/SUM(ECL) | % | Lower | portfolio-period | Share of booked ECL |

| M013 | Default count | Both | COUNT(new default entities) | count | Lower | entity-period | Distinct governed entity id |

| M019 | Utilisation rate | Both | SUM(drawn)/SUM(limit or drawn+undrawn) | % | Context | facility/account-period | Denominator definition domain-specific |
| M020 | Top-10 concentration | Both | SUM(top10 EAD)/SUM(EAD) | % | Lower | portfolio-period | Rank after active filters |

| M026 | Behaviour score movement | Retail | AVG(score_t-score_t-1) | points | Metadata | customer/account-transition | Directionality from model metadata |
